description: Ministry of Public Administration, Management and Law & Order - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1777/35 of 27.09.2012: Minute of Office Emplooyees'Service - Rivision No. 02
reasoning: This gazette contains a revision to the "Minute of Office Employees' Service" ordered by the Public Service Commission, specifically addressing efficiency bar examinations for public service employees. This falls under public sector administration and service conditions, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8) rather than a government personnel or structural change.
